        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Tweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegistrationSystem" name="Registration System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckSlots</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SlotsFree</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoSlots</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Ticket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Registration wanted"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsFree" name="Slots free?" default="Flow_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCourses" name="Show courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourseDate" name="Select one course and date"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check if you already have an account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasAccount" name="Has account?" default="Flow_NoAccount"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check whether you are registered at an eligible university"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Eligible" name="Eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Msg_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountMerge" name="Account available"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into account"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccountToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_HasAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccountYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Eligible" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResponseToMerge" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToSplit" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToTweet" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_Tweet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToJoin" sourceRef="Task_Tweet" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToTicket" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TicketToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="End_Ticket"/>
